answer: Freeze reputation like tundra: new identities start at zero, standing thaws only as attested work accumulates epoch by epoch, and no capital thaws it faster — clones cannot inherit warmth. Trace vouching as a ripple: each endorsement spreads with geometric decay, so a fake identity's attestation pool stays shallow and inspectable at every hop, not a solid wall. Build the reward base like a reef: payouts accrete from distinct non-kin endorsers — each fake identity must recruit its own genuine reef, and per-identity cost compounds with no shared layer to exploit.
